meta.title: Trip Finder Quiz · Find Your Perfect Sri Lanka Route
meta.description: Answer four quick questions about your party, trip length, passions and season — and I will match you with the private Sri Lanka journey that suits you best, ready to tailor.

hero.title: Find Your Perfect Sri Lankan Odyssey
hero.intro: Answer four curated curiosities to reveal the hand-crafted expedition blueprint attuned to your passions, group rhythm, and preferred season.

party.title: Who will be joining you on this Ceylon journey?
party.intro: I tailor vehicle proportions, villa acoustics, and expedition pacing according to your travel arrangement.
party.error: Please choose who is travelling to continue.

duration.title: What is your ideal journey duration?
duration.intro: Sri Lanka is compact yet geographically diverse; I balance scenic drive windows with unhurried villa leisure.
duration.error: Please choose a journey length to continue.

passions.title: What experiences captivate your curiosity most?
passions.intro: Select up to three key facets so I can plan specialist lecturers and the right timing windows.
passions.error: Please choose at least one experience to continue.
passions.limit: You can choose up to {max} experiences — deselect one to pick another.

season.title: When do you plan to arrive in Sri Lanka?
season.intro: Sri Lanka experiences dual monsoon systems, guaranteeing that one coast or mountain region is always basked in radiant weather.
season.error: Please choose an arrival season to see your route.

couple.title: Romantic Couple / Honeymoon
couple.description: Secluded architectural villas, candlelit Ceylon tea bungalows, discreet private chauffeur pacing.

solo.title: Solo Explorer
solo.description: Autonomous sunrise photography, deep Buddhist monastic discussions, flexible unplanned stops.

family.title: Family with Children
family.description: Kid-tested safari naturalists, gentle travel legs, connecting suites, and safe coastal surf bays.

group.title: Friends & Small Group
group.description: Boutique estate buyouts, convivial private chef dinners, mountain treks, and heritage bar curations.

corporate.title: Executive Delegation / Retreat
corporate.description: Discreet VIP transport, Geoffrey Bawa architectural venues, confidential meetings, and custom gala hosting.

short.title: The Essential Ceylon Accent
short.description: Focused regional immersion. Ideal for pairing either the misty tea highlands and cultural triangle, or a wildlife safari and pristine southern coastline.

balanced.title: The Balanced Grand Circuit
balanced.description: The quintessential Ceylon narrative: UNESCO ancient kingdoms, the world-famed scenic blue train through tea estates, untamed leopard safari, and Galle colonial ramparts.

deep.title: The Immersive In-Depth Odyssey
deep.description: Unrushed double-night stays at premier tea bungalows. Incorporates secluded northern heritage (Jaffna / Wilpattu) alongside the southern coast and tea country.

grand.title: The Connoisseur's Slow Expedition
grand.description: Total serenity. Extended multi-day wellness immersions, rare wildlife sanctuaries, private boat charters, and deep culinary exploration with master chefs.

citadels.title: Ancient Citadels & UNESCO Ruins
citadels.description: Sigiriya dawn ascents, Polonnaruwa royal stone palaces, and sacred Dambulla cave murals.

safari.title: Leopards, Elephants & Safari
safari.description: Yala Block 1 uncrowded dawn entries, sloth bear tracking, and private naturalist accompaniment.

tea.title: Misty Tea Country & Railways
tea.description: Reserved observation train cars, colonial tea planter bungalows, and private tastings.

coast.title: Pristine South Beaches & Galle Fort
coast.description: Catamaran blue whale spotting, Dutch colonial ramparts, and secluded coastal bays.

trekking.title: High-Altitude Trekking & Peaks
trekking.description: World’s End precipice at Horton Plains, secluded Knuckles range pathways, and waterfall descents.

wellness.title: Ayurvedic Sanctuary & Forest Zen
wellness.description: Authentic physician-guided herbal panchakarma, yoga pavilions, and farm-to-table organic dining.

nov-apr.title: Southwest Coast & Central Highlands
nov-apr.description: Golden calm seas at Galle & Bentota, blue skies over tea plantations, and optimal leopard visibility in Yala and Udawalawe.

may-sep.title: East Coast & Northern Peninsula
may-sep.description: Crystal-clear diving seas in Trincomalee and Pasikudah, serene Jaffna cultural exploration, and dry conditions across Wilpattu.

jul-aug.title: The Esala Perahera Festival & The Elephant Gathering
jul-aug.description: Kandy’s spellbinding sacred relic pageant with torchbearers, paired with the awe-inspiring 300+ elephant assembly at Minneriya reservoir.

flexible.title: I'd Like Dinesh's Recommendation
flexible.description: I will weigh flight convenience, hotel seasonality, and festival dates to suggest your premier travel window.

process.intro: From quiz submission to stepping off your flight at Bandaranaike International, every detail is personally overseen.

analysis.title: Profile Analysis
analysis.body: Within minutes of your inquiry, I examine your chosen travel season, party configuration, and desired sights against current road and weather conditions.

lockin.title: Boutique Villa Lock-in
lockin.body: I cross-check availability with my trusted partners: tea planter bungalows, heritage Galle manses, and reserved scenic train compartments.

portfolio.title: Tailored Itinerary Portfolio
portfolio.body: You receive an elegant, day-by-day customized journey portfolio with hand-picked suites, recommended dining, vehicle details, and clear terms.
